items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: And Raffaella and them, I liked it and everywhere they'd go, I'd go. Everywhere I'd know they got to dance, I'd run behind them until I learned how to play.

ctx.x: Just picked it up. Just picked it up like this. They went on and played and hang around them until I learned. And went on and played different jazz with them. Well, first time, you know, you get cold feet and just kept on until I learned. Sure. But sometime I'd go there and the pieces I could play, well, they'd play for me to catch on and that's how I come on. So that's how I got to learn. And Raffaella and them, I liked it and everywhere they'd go, I'd go. Everywhere I'd know they got to dance, I'd run behind…
Do you remember any of them?
